style: Cut-out film prop, isolated on a fully transparent background, no backdrop, no text. Heavy aged fabric with visible weave, dust and worn edges, lit from behind so the cloth glows at its torn edges.

items.name: flag_fr
items.prompt: A torn French tricolour flag on a wooden pole, blue-white-red vertical bands, the red browned and dirty, edges frayed and burnt, hanging at an angle as if in still air. LIGHTING: strong backlight from the upper left so the cloth glows and the pole reads as a dark silhouette.

items.name: flag_red
items.prompt: A large tattered red banner on a rough pole, cloth heavy and stained dark at the bottom, folds deep, edges frayed. LIGHTING: hard warm backlight from behind, the banner glowing crimson at the edges, the pole a black silhouette.
